question: How does the entire multiplicity of things appear in consciousness, and who realizes this?
premises: The whole expanded group of things appears in the self of consciousness.
One for whom it appears thus is the Lord of the universe.
inference: To see all multiplicity as a reflection in consciousness is to stand in the realization of universal lordship.
plain_english: This whole expanded group of things shines in the self of consciousness as a reflection; one for whom it appears thus is indeed the Lord of the universe.
